description: Trigger download delivery for a file-based identity match job. Always delivers to download — returns a signed URL to the enriched output file. Use this instead of deliver_audience for matched segments created via create_segment(subtype=matched). The match_id is the segment_id returned by create_segment(subtype=matched) — delivery still routes through an audience wrapper internally. Matched segments do not support LiveRamp or Narrative destinations. Supply template_id OR field_list — not both. Use get_field_catalog() to browse options. Completion or failure may notify configured external webhooks and opted-in users by email; completion may also email the delivery creator and configured organization contacts. Requires 'creator' scope.

field_list.description: Custom list of field names to include. Mutually exclusive with template_id.

include_unmatched.description: Include rows that did not resolve to a known identity. Defaults to true.

match_id.description: The segment_id returned by create_segment(subtype=matched) — also accepted as match_id for backward compatibility

output_compression.description: Explicit output compression. gzip supports csv/json/jsonl; Avro uses native DEFLATE.

output_format.description: Output file format. Defaults to csv if not specified.

template_id.description: Enrichment template ID from get_field_catalog(). Mutually exclusive with field_list.

webhook_url.description: Optional HTTPS URL to notify when delivery completes.

name: deliver_file_match

count_state.description: Unknown means no count; available does not guarantee freshness. Recount for a current value.

download_urls.description: Fresh signed artifact URLs on an individual completed download delivery

guidance.description: Interpretation or recovery guidance for this result

next_actions.description: Suggested next calls using returned IDs and available scopes. Not executed and not user consent.

page_count.description: Number of objects on this page, not the organization total

population_input.description: Population input used for the preview; IDs refer to their current saved definitions

title: Deliver File Match
